column2: Built into macOS. Words appear as you speak, about 2 seconds behind you.
Built into macOS and made for long recordings. The first words take about 4 seconds, then follow about a second behind you.
Text appears in steps about every 2 seconds. Strong in English, weaker in Polish; the three step sizes scored about the same.
Text appears in steps about every second. Strong in English, weaker in Polish; the three step sizes scored about the same.
Text appears in steps about every half second, the quickest of the three. Strong in English, weaker in Polish; the three step sizes scored about the same.
Words appear about a second and a half after you start and keep up with you closely. Strong in English, weaker in Polish.
Parakeet v3 writes in blocks, not word by word: the first text appears about 13 seconds after you start, then every 11 seconds, and the rest when you stop. It covers 25 languages, including Polish.
English only. The seconds in the name are how often text appears: shorter is quicker but less accurate, and on long continuous speech the shortest steps can drop a sentence.
English only. Text appears in short pieces about once a second, starting about 3 seconds after you start.
